title: UL 10010-7 Part B: Flooring EPD Requirements

document.status_note: The PCR states a 5-year validity ending September 2023 (p.3); ul.com PCR list shows 'Flooring (North America)' valid under an extension to 31 Dec 2026 (checked 2026-10-12).

depends_on_unavailable: UL Environment Part A v3.2 (Sept 2018): indicator Tables 4-8, cut-off rules (2.9), data quality (3.1.1), allocation (3.3), averaging methods (2.5.1/2.5.2), packaging defaults (2.8.5 Table 3), disposal routes (2.8.5/2.8.6), hazardous substances (4.11), RSL rules (2.8.2), variation criteria (Section 5)
CA Specification 01350 v1.2 (VOC emissions test method)
Product specification standards listed in Section 9 (e.g. ANSI A137.1 for ceramic tile)

rules.title: Product is a flooring product in scope
rules.requirement: The PCR covers installed residential and commercial flooring: carpet/textile, ceramic tile, laminate, resilient (plastics, linoleum, cork, rubber) and wood flooring.

rules.title: Excluded products not declared
rules.requirement: Stone products, fluid-applied flooring (CSI 09 67 00), resinous flooring (09 67 50) and loose-laid resilient mats are outside the scope.

rules.title: Not a stone or loose-laid mat product
rules.requirement: Stone flooring and loose-laid mats are excluded from the scope.

rules.title: Classification within listed CSI / UNSPSC codes
rules.requirement: The product should fall under UNSPSC 30161700 or the listed CSI MasterFormat 09 60 00 / 09 30 00 sub-codes.

rules.title: Packaged product incl. adhesives and sealants
rules.requirement: The PCR applies to the whole packaged product for individual sale, including supplied adhesives and sealants.

rules.title: EPD scope is cradle to grave
rules.requirement: EPDs under this PCR are cradle to grave.

rules.title: EPD type is industry-average or product-specific
rules.requirement: The EPD type must be declared as either industry-average or product-specific.

rules.title: Conforms to ISO 21930:2017
rules.requirement: EPDs must conform to ISO 21930:2017; EN 15804 conformance is optional.

rules.title: Industry-average EPD: at least 3 sites from 3 companies
rules.requirement: An industry-average EPD should represent at least three manufacturing locations from at least three companies, unless justified.

rules.title: Industry-average EPD expires after 5 years
rules.requirement: Industry-average EPDs created with this PCR expire five years after publication.

rules.title: Industry-average EPD reports variability
rules.requirement: Industry-average EPDs must report the variability of the data (mean, median, standard deviation).

rules.title: Industry-average averaging method described
rules.requirement: The method used to create an industry-average EPD must be described, and technical data averaged using each participant's production volume as weights.

rules.title: Industry-average min/max per impact category in LCA report
rules.requirement: The LCA background report for an industry-average EPD should record the maximum and minimum result per impact category across participating products or facilities.

rules.title: Functional unit is 1 m2 of floor covering
rules.requirement: Results are expressed per one square metre of floor covering.

rules.title: Mass per functional unit declared
rules.requirement: The mass (kg) of the declared product per functional unit must be stated, including installation materials when those are declared.

rules.title: Mass based on material before yield losses
rules.requirement: Mass (and density) must be the total material needed to produce 1 m2 before yield losses, including facing and ancillary materials.

rules.title: Product weight in technical data matches FU mass
rules.requirement: The product weight in g/m2 in the technical data table should agree with the mass per functional unit.

rules.title: All modules A1-C4 reported
rules.requirement: Product stage, construction stage, use stage (B1-B7, scenario-based) and end-of-life stage (C1-C4) modules are all required.

rules.title: Product stage as A1-A3 or A1, A2, A3
rules.requirement: A1, A2 and A3 may be reported individually or aggregated as A1-A3.

rules.title: Module D optional
rules.requirement: Module D (benefits beyond the system boundary) is optional; when declared, its scenario information (Table 17) must be given.

rules.title: Capital goods and infrastructure excluded
rules.requirement: Capital goods and infrastructure flows are deemed insignificant for flooring and must be excluded from the LCIA model.

rules.title: RSL declared
rules.requirement: The RSL must be indicated because the EPD covers the full use stage (B1-B7).

rules.title: Building ESL is 75 years
rules.requirement: Replacements are calculated over a 75-year building estimated service life.

rules.title: RSL reference in-use conditions declared
rules.requirement: The RSL must be accompanied by its reference in-use conditions (product properties, design application, installation quality, indoor/outdoor environment, use conditions, maintenance, as relevant).

rules.title: RSL applicability statement present
rules.requirement: The EPD must state that the RSL applies only to the declared reference in-use conditions.

any_of: applies only to the reference in-use conditions

rules.title: Intended application and RSL description in general information
rules.requirement: The general information block must describe the intended application and use (as used to set the RSL) and the product RSL.

rules.title: A4 transport defaults to 800 km diesel truck (North America)
rules.requirement: For North American sales without primary data, transport to site is 800 km by diesel truck/trailer; deviations (e.g. other geographies) must be justified.
rules.applies_when: 'North America' in epd.markets or 'US' in epd.markets or 'Canada' in epd.markets

rules.title: A4 scenario table fields present
rules.requirement: Transport to site must report fuel type, fuel use (l/100 km), vehicle type, distance, mass-based capacity utilisation, gross density (or weight and volume) and capacity utilisation volume factor.

rules.title: A4 gross density, or weight and volume
rules.requirement: Either the gross density of transported products or both their weight and volume must be reported.

rules.title: A5 scenario table fields present
rules.requirement: Installation must report ancillary materials, water by source and fate, other resources, electricity, other energy, product loss, installation waste, outputs of on-site waste processing, packaging waste by type, biogenic carbon in packaging (kg CO2), direct emissions and VOC emissions (µg/m3).

rules.title: VOC emissions tested per CA Specification 01350
rules.requirement: VOC emissions must be determined with the CA Specification 01350 (v1.2) environmental chamber method.

rules.title: Installation defaults to manual with no energy
rules.requirement: Without primary data, installation and deconstruction are manual with no operational energy; deviations must be justified.

rules.title: Installation method described
rules.requirement: The installation description must cover processing, machinery, tools, dust extraction and auxiliary materials used.

rules.title: Cleaning frequency and products declared
rules.requirement: Use-stage impacts depend on cleaning: cleaning frequency and cleaning products must follow the manufacturer's recommendations, or documented assumptions when no primary data exist.

rules.title: B2 scenario table fields present
rules.requirement: Maintenance must report process information, cycles per RSL and ESL, water, ancillary materials (e.g. cleaning agent), other resources, energy input, other energy carriers, equipment power output, maintenance waste and direct emissions.

rules.title: Maintenance cycles per ESL consistent with per RSL
rules.requirement: Maintenance cycles over the ESL should equal cycles per RSL scaled by ESL/RSL.

rules.title: B3 scenario table fields present
rules.requirement: Repair must report repair and inspection process information, cycles per RSL and ESL, water, ancillary materials, energy input, repair waste and direct emissions.

rules.title: Replacement cycles = ESL / RSL - 1
rules.requirement: The number of replacements over the 75-year building ESL must be declared, calculated as ESL divided by RSL minus one.

rules.title: Replacements rounded up to nearest tenth
rules.requirement: Replacement counts should be rounded up to the nearest tenth (e.g. 1.47 to 1.5).

rules.title: Replacements declared when RSL < 75 years
rules.requirement: If the RSL is shorter than the 75-year ESL, the replacements needed over the ESL must be identified.

rules.title: B4 scenario table fields present
rules.requirement: Replacement must report RSL, replacement cycle, energy input, water, ancillary materials, replaced worn parts and direct emissions.

rules.title: B4 impacts approximately cycles x (A1-A5)
rules.requirement: Module B4 reflects producing and installing the replacement products, so it should approximate replacement cycles times the A1-A5 total.

check.expression: abs(results.GWP.B4 - scenarios.B4.replacement_cycles * (results.GWP['A1-A3'] + results.GWP.A4 + results.GWP.A5)) <= 0.10 * abs(scenarios.B4.replacement_cycles * (results.GWP['A1-A3'] + results.GWP.A4 + results.GWP.A5))

rules.title: B5 scenario table fields present
rules.requirement: Refurbishment must report process description, cycles per RSL and ESL, energy input, water, material inputs incl. ancillary materials, waste and direct emissions.

rules.title: B6/B7 scenario table fields present
rules.requirement: Operational energy and water must report water by source and fate, ancillary materials, energy input, equipment power output, characteristic performance and direct emissions.

rules.title: C2 waste transport defaults to 161 km diesel truck (North America)
rules.requirement: For North American sales without primary data, transport to waste processing is 161 km by diesel truck/trailer; deviations must be justified.
rules.applies_when: 'North America' in epd.markets or 'US' in epd.markets or 'Canada' in epd.markets

rules.title: End-of-life table fields present
rules.requirement: End of life must report scenario assumptions, mass collected separately and with mixed waste, reuse, recycling, landfill, incineration, incineration with energy recovery (with conversion efficiency), final deposition, and biogenic carbon removals excluding packaging.

rules.title: End-of-life routes account for product mass
rules.requirement: Reuse, recycling, landfill, incineration and energy-recovery masses should together account for the product mass per functional unit.

check.expression: abs(scenarios.C.reuse_kg + scenarios.C.recycling_kg + scenarios.C.landfill_kg + scenarios.C.incineration_kg + scenarios.C.incineration_energy_recovery_kg - product.mass_per_unit_kg) <= 0.05 * product.mass_per_unit_kg

rules.title: Exported energy from waste treatment reported
rules.requirement: Net energy benefits from energy recovery in C3 (R>0.6), thermal treatment in C4 (R<0.6) and material flows to energy recovery must be reported in MJ with process efficiencies.

rules.title: Ceramic tile technical data
rules.requirement: Ceramic tile EPDs must give class (P1-P4, E1-E4 or O1-O4), tile type, grade (standard or second), facial area (mm2), thickness (mm), product weight (g/m2) and dimensional category, each with its test standard.

rules.title: Ceramic tile class value valid
rules.requirement: Tile class must be one of P1-P4, E1-E4 or O1-O4.

rules.title: Ceramic tile type valid
rules.requirement: Tile type must be porcelain, pressed floor, mosaic, quarry, gauged or glass.

rules.title: Ceramic tile grade and dimensional category valid
rules.requirement: Grade must be standard or second, and dimensional category natural, calibrated or rectified.

rules.title: Carpet technical data
rules.requirement: Carpet EPDs must give yarn type, primary and secondary backing types, CRI rating (2.5 moderate, 3.0 heavy, 3.5 severe), total thickness, product weight, surface pile thickness and surface pile weight.

rules.title: Carpet CRI rating valid
rules.requirement: CRI rating must be 2.5 (moderate), 3.0 (heavy) or 3.5 (severe).

rules.title: Laminate technical data
rules.requirement: Laminate EPDs must give use rating, core type, thickness (mm), length and width (m), product weight (g/m2), density, and underlayment weight if attached.

rules.title: Resilient flooring technical data with min/avg/max
rules.requirement: Resilient flooring EPDs must give average, minimum and maximum product thickness, wear layer thickness (where applicable), product weight and product form dimensions (rolls, tiles or planks).

rules.title: Resilient min <= average <= max
rules.requirement: For resilient flooring ranges, the average must lie between the minimum and maximum.

rules.title: Wood flooring technical data
rules.requirement: Wood flooring EPDs must give thickness (mm), width (mm) and product weight (g/m2).

rules.title: Wood flooring dimensions within typical range
rules.requirement: Wood flooring is typically 5/16 in to 1 in thick (about 7.9-25.4 mm) and 1.5 in to 10 in wide (about 38-254 mm); values outside should be checked.

rules.title: Technical data cite test standards
rules.requirement: Each technical data value must reference the test standard used.

rules.title: Product specification standard provided
rules.requirement: The applicable ASTM or ANSI product specification must be stated (e.g. ANSI A137.1 for ceramic tile, ASTM F1700 for solid vinyl tile).

rules.title: Ceramic tile specification standard is ANSI A137.x
rules.requirement: Ceramic, glass and gauged porcelain tile reference ANSI A137.1, A137.2 or A137.3 respectively.

rules.title: Market placement codes and regulations indicated
rules.requirement: The applicable standards, technical approvals or national regulations must be indicated, with a link to the evaluation report or certification where one exists.

rules.title: Material composition as % by mass
rules.requirement: Main components and materials must be listed as percentage by mass.

rules.title: Composition percentages total 100%
rules.requirement: Material shares should add up to the whole product.

rules.title: Additives declared with functional chemical group
rules.requirement: Ancillary materials and additives remaining in the product must be declared; flame retardants, softeners and biocides must state their functional chemical group.

rules.title: No 'free of' or 'harmless' claims
rules.requirement: Non-inclusion statements such as 'free of' and interpretive claims such as 'entirely harmless' are not permitted.

rules.title: Hazardous substances reported
rules.requirement: Regulated hazardous and dangerous substances must be reported according to Part A Section 4.11.

rules.title: Packaging declared with end-of-life pathway
rules.requirement: Each packaging material must be described by type and composition with its disposal pathway (reuse, recycling or landfill).

rules.title: Biogenic carbon reporting when >10% biogenic content
rules.requirement: If the product has more than 10% biogenic content or biogenic carbon is in the reported GWP, carbon emissions and removals (Part A Table 6) must be reported.

rules.title: Biogenic carbon excluded from GWP otherwise
rules.requirement: When biogenic content is 10% or less and biogenic carbon reporting is not used, biogenic carbon must be excluded from GWP.

rules.title: General information table complete
rules.requirement: The general information block must include program and operator, program instructions and version, manufacturer name and address, declaration number, declared product and functional unit, reference PCR and version, markets, issue date, validity period, EPD type and scope, years of primary data, LCA software, LCI databases and LCIA method (with versions), and who reviewed the PCR, conducted and verified the LCA.

rules.title: LCA software, database and LCIA method versions stated
rules.requirement: LCA software, LCI database(s) and LCIA methodology must each be named with versions, along with the year(s) of primary data.

rules.title: Comparability limitation statement present
rules.requirement: The EPD must state that declarations from different programs may not be comparable and that comparisons must be made at building level.

rules.title: Manufacturer named
rules.requirement: The manufacturing entity (or entities) must be named.

rules.title: Manufacturing process and locations described
rules.requirement: The manufacturing process and all production locations must be described.

rules.title: Product identification with brand and image
rules.requirement: Products must be identified by brand name, material type, production code if applicable, and a photo or illustration.

rules.title: Production flow diagram included
rules.requirement: A flow diagram of the main production processes within the declared scope must be included.

rules.title: Product-specific averaging method described
rules.requirement: For product-group EPDs, the production-volume weighting method must be described.

rules.title: Intended application specified
rules.requirement: The intended application(s) of the product must be specified.

rules.title: No-exclusion statement present
rules.requirement: The methodological framework must include the statement that no known flows are deliberately excluded.

any_of: no known flows are deliberately excluded

rules.title: Cut-off and allocation procedures described
rules.requirement: Cut-off and allocation procedures must be described per Part A Sections 2.9 and 3.3.

rules.title: Re-use, recycling and energy recovery possibilities described
rules.requirement: Possibilities for re-use, recycling and energy recovery must be described.

rules.title: Disposal channels indicated
rules.requirement: Possible disposal channels must be indicated per the Part A disposal routes and waste classification.

rules.title: Interpretation section present
rules.requirement: The EPD must include an interpretation of assumptions and limitations, including the variance of results when the EPD covers several products.

rules.title: Certification details location stated
rules.requirement: For each certification listed in the EPD, a statement must say where details of the certification program can be found.

rules.title: This Part B PCR referenced
rules.requirement: The EPD's references must cite this Part B PCR.

rules.title: Period under review documented
rules.requirement: The period under review used for averages must be documented.

rules.title: Data quality evaluation provided
rules.requirement: Data quality must be evaluated for temporal, geographical and technological representativeness and completeness.

rules.title: Missing supporting documentation explained
rules.requirement: If supporting documentation (test protocols, certificates) is not provided, the EPD must state why.

rules.title: Mass-based allocation unless justified
rules.requirement: Co-product allocation uses mass as the primary basis; other bases require justification, and allocations for recycled inputs and shared factory energy must be indicated.

rules.title: LCIA results in scientific notation, 3 digits
rules.requirement: LCIA results must be declared for each module in scientific notation with three significant digits, formatted uniformly.

rules.title: SI units for all results
rules.requirement: All LCA results must be given in SI units; regional units are optional extras.

rules.title: TRACI results for North American market
rules.requirement: EPDs for North America declare LCIA results with the TRACI indicators of Part A Table 7.
rules.applies_when: 'North America' in epd.markets or 'US' in epd.markets or 'Canada' in epd.markets

rules.title: CML results for EU market
rules.requirement: EPDs for the EU declare LCIA results with the CML indicators of Part A Table 8.

rules.title: LCI resource use and waste indicators reported
rules.requirement: Resource use indicators (Part A Table 4) and output flow and waste category indicators (Part A Table 5) must be reported.

rules.title: Verification type declared
rules.requirement: The EPD must state whether ISO 14025 verification was internal or external.

manual_checks.title: Industry-average call for participation published
manual_checks.reason: Requires evidence of a notice in at least one trade publication.

manual_checks.title: Retroactive participation in industry-average EPD
manual_checks.reason: Program operator decision based on practitioner recommendation.

manual_checks.title: Confidential data handled by a third-party industry agent
manual_checks.reason: Process and governance requirement; not visible in EPD data.

manual_checks.title: Industry-average EPD uses latest software and impact assessment versions
manual_checks.reason: 'Most recent available' version needs a current external reference list.

manual_checks.title: Omitted aspects justified
manual_checks.reason: Adequacy of justification needs reviewer judgement.

manual_checks.title: Deviations from default scenarios explained
manual_checks.reason: Software checks that a justification exists; its adequacy needs review.

manual_checks.title: Confidential composition exemptions
manual_checks.reason: Withholding proprietary composition is allowed with justification; acceptability is a reviewer decision.

manual_checks.title: B4/B5 assumptions supported by manufacturer documentation
manual_checks.reason: Requires reviewing manufacturer guidelines and supporting documents.

manual_checks.title: Health and environment information (manufacturing, installation)
manual_checks.reason: Narrative content; presence can be checked but not quality.

manual_checks.title: Extraordinary effects (fire, water, mechanical destruction)
manual_checks.reason: 'Should' narrative sections; relevance depends on the product.

manual_checks.title: Statements backed by measured data and detection limits

notes: Validity: the PCR text says it expires September 2023, but UL lists an extension to 31 Dec 2026; valid_until uses the extension date.
Table 2 (ceramic tile) lists the unit for 'Grade (standard or second)' as mm; grade is categorical, so the rule treats it as a text value.
Table 3 (laminate) gives density in g/m3, which is implausible for laminate; it is likely kg/m3 or g/cm3. The rule only checks that density is present.

Section 2.12 points to 'Section 4, Table 6' for RSL assumptions and 3.1 points to 'Table 3' for mass; the actual tables are Table 10 (RSL) and Table 6 (functional unit). Section II refers to product standards in 'Section 8' but they are listed in Section 9.
Table 11 gives 'Other energy carriers specified by type' in kWh rather than MJ.

Differences from the chiller PCR (UL 10010-4): Module D is optional here (not allowed for chillers); capital goods must be excluded; industry-average EPDs are allowed; default A4 is 800 km and C2 161 km (chillers: 500 km / 100 km); no default refrigerant or RSL value.
The PCR sets no default RSL for flooring; the RSL must come from the manufacturer with reference in-use conditions.
The 10% biogenic content threshold (Section 5) decides whether carbon emissions/removals are reported or biogenic carbon is excluded from GWP.
Indicator names, units and cut-off percentages are defined in UL Part A v3.2, which is not available, so IND rules check only that the indicator groups exist.

New field paths introduced: product.sub_category values (carpet, ceramic_tile, laminate, resilient, wood), product.technical_data.{material_family, tile_class, tile_type, grade, facial_area_mm2, thickness_mm, product_weight_g_m2, dimensional_category, yarn_type, primary_backing, secondary_backing, cri_rating, total_thickness_mm, pile_thickness_mm, pile_weight_g_m2, use_rating, core_type, length_m, width_m, width_mm, density, underlayment_weight_g_m2, product_form}, product.packaged_contents, product.mass_basis, product.specification_standard, product.additives[], product.certifications[], product.biogenic_content_pct, lca.participants.{sites, companies, justification}, lca.capital_goods_included, lca.gwp_includes_biogenic, results.variability, scenarios.A4.{fuel_type, vehicle_type, weight_kg, volume_m3}, scenarios.A5.{voc_emissions_ug_m3, voc_test_method, packaging_waste_kg, packaging_biogenic_carbon_kg_co2}, scenarios.B2.{cleaning_frequency, cleaning_products, cleaning_data_source}, scenarios.C.* (Table 16 routes), scenarios.D.*, document.sections.{market_placement, installation, rsl_description, supporting_documentation}.
